invariants.rationale: If result is true, the method's returned value must match exactly the right-hand side of the return expression.

invariants.expression: result == (focusTraversal && (character == TAB || ((character == CARRIAGE_RETURN || character == NEWLINE) && (UIUtils.isAndroid || UIUtils.isIos))))
invariants.rationale: The returned result is exactly the computed Boolean from the method body.

invariants.expression: character == TAB || character == CARRIAGE_RETURN || character == NEWLINE || !result
invariants.rationale: Result can only be true if the character is one of the expected values.
If focusTraversal is false, result must be false.

invariants.expression: result || !focusTraversal || (character != TAB && (character != CARRIAGE_RETURN && character != NEWLINE || !(UIUtils.isAndroid || UIUtils.isIos)))
invariants.rationale: If result is false, this is equivalent to the negation of the condition for returning true.
